verdict.rationale: Token2 documents desktop, mobile and CLI management tools (fido2-manage) and a bulk-enrollment script, but no public API of its own. The bulk-enrollment tool calls Microsoft's Graph API, which is a host-platform API rather than Token2's. The CLI belongs to a separate story, and probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs all returned 404, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
